title: UV filters spotlight: Environmental impact and SPF testing methods
summary: Industry needs to take a multistakeholder approach to measuring the environmental impact of UV filters and continue to invest in new SPF testing methods and better consumer education, say experts. Addressing attendees at this year's UK Cosmetic, Toiletry and Perfumery Association's (CTPA) inaugural scientific conference, two sunscreen experts said scientific gaps must be plugged and advances followed to keep data and knowledge relevant and reliable.
